def build(rawdir):
    rows = []

        run = agg.Run(f)
        rows += [r for r in make_diag.part2_cells(run, seed=0) if r["s"] > 0]

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def features(c):

            "S_bar (pre-registered)": np.log(c.S_h1.values + 0.01)}


def design(c, x):
    cols = [np.ones(len(c)), c.logn.values] + ([x] if x is not None else [])
    return np.column_stack(cols)


def benchmarks(c):
    return {"mean_degree": np.log(c.d.values), "p(1-p)": np.log(c.p.values * (1 - c.p.values)), "n p(1-p)/d": np.log(c.n.values * c.p.values * (1 - c.p.values) / c.d.values)}
